display_name: LoRa W24 观测条件化整包复数速度场（Full）
description: From-scratch observation-conditioned packet rectified flow. Compare one vs four fixed forward Euler steps, one set of weights, equal external readout fraction.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native source split 392005; disjoint 16000 fit pool/160 waveform holdout; frozen 300 source V and native archived Full receipts.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: 386933 new trainable parameters from scratch, analytic tracker and generic native pairing code only.

sources.role: Frozen source predictions used as a matched comparison after both scratch candidates freeze
Pinned analytic aperture, tracking and generic waveform generator code only, no learned checkpoint

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No historical restoration weight used in fit, freeze or candidate predictions. Historical outer predictions appended by unchanged physical order for post-freeze paired scoring only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at 16000 steps. The preregistered four-step half readout must meet parent+18 six, parent+10 low, clean>=direct, and beat the one-step half on both practical metrics to promote. No source checkpoint selection.

execution.gpu_policy: One N607 GPU, 3 then 6,0, >=12 GiB free and existing process cap. 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid read permission, real smoke failure, nonfinite loss/holdout, output shape/IDs or history parity, missing views or independent score failure.

metric_names: disturbed and clean source waveform errors by one/four steps
paired Full source accuracy and intervals

rows.method: Matched one/four Euler steps with the same from-scratch observation and current state-conditioned complex velocity. Each fixed at 0.5 and 1.0 external writeback, original native edges.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 16000 updates, batch 8 (one clean identity), AdamW cosine .0006 to .00008, fixed source waveform metrics at 2000/8000/16000. Seven frozen Full source views over 300 matched packets.

notes: Single training arm, 128000 source presentations including generic same-item impairment pairs and one clean identity per minibatch.
25% of the source time draws are exactly t=0. Remaining times are uniform on the clean path. Velocity target is clean minus observed in the receiver coordinate frame.
Inference starts at observed IQ with measured high-frequency median, public analytic tracker and received phase/quality. Fixed one/four Euler steps, zero random draws and no edits to native edges.
Only final source weights proceed to frozen W24. Direct predictions compared exactly, frozen outer rows appended by physical order. No new Residual.
CPU trajectory, gradient, known-field integration and real N607 source smoke coverage. One independent P0/P1 review.
